pages.text: The 5 tags introduced in this section mainly affect a neko's $(#FF69B4)combat style$() and $(#FF69B4)safe distance$(). If you're looking for a bodyguard or a cautious companion, pay attention to these tags~

pages.title: tsundere · Tsundere
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"I-It's not like I'm following you because I want to!"$()$(br2)Tsundere nekos act reluctant on the surface, but deep down it's a different story. However, she does have a $(#FF69B4)8% chance$() of refusing your follow command — she'll say "no" at first, but quietly follow along moments later.$(br2)This love-hate cuteness is the very charm of tsundere!

pages.title: yandere · Yandere
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Anyone who hurts my owner... must die."$()$(br2)Yandere nekos have an extreme protective instinct toward their owners. If $(#FF69B4)anyone attacks the owner$(), she will retaliate within a 12-block range.$(br2)Her follow range is the longest of all — $(#FF69B4)40 blocks$(). No matter how far her owner goes, she'll keep a close watch.$(br2)With her around, you'll feel incredibly safe... though sometimes a little chilled down the spine too.

pages.title: yowaki · Timid
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Uu... don't come closer..."$()$(br2)Timid nekos are very shy and will actively $(#FF69B4)flee from strangers$(). Her follow range is also shorter — $(#FF69B4)15 blocks$() — she gets anxious if separated by too much distance.$(br2)She needs more patience and care from her owner, but once trust is built, she becomes one of the clingiest nekos around.

pages.title: paranoia · Paranoid
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Someone's watching..."$()$(br2)Paranoid nekos stay vigilant at all times. She $(#FF69B4)scans every 2 seconds$() for unknown players within an 8-block radius, and flees immediately upon detection.$(br2)In crowded areas, she can barely settle down. If you have a paranoid neko, it's best to take her somewhere quiet to live.

pages.title: shoakuma · Little Devil
pages.text: $(#FF69B4)"Ehehe~ this belongs to me now~"$()$(br2)Little Devil nekos love mischief. Her $(#FF69B4)item pickup range is larger than normal$() (5 blocks vs the default 3) — anything dropped nearby gets secretly snatched up by her.$(br2)While not directly combat-related, this tag means she'll always end up with more loot during chaotic moments — maybe even that thing you just dropped?
